note: Every dated evidence event for active problems, newest first. Event IDs are stable content hashes. Poll release.json first; this file is a snapshot of recorded evidence. The append-only sequenced ledger is events.json.

events.title: Clay continues to list the problem as unsolved
events.detail: The official Clay page says that experiments and simulations support a mass gap but no proof meeting the mathematical problem is known.

events.title: A candidate family is two-copy distillable in every dimension
events.detail: Tabia, Chen and Hsieh prove two-copy distillability for selected one-copy-undistillable NPT states in every local dimension at least three. This removes candidates rather than producing bound entanglement.

events.title: Selected NPT candidates fail at two copies
events.detail: An exact all-dimension theorem proves two-copy distillability for selected one-copy-undistillable candidates.

events.problemTitle: Entanglement of formation for Gaussian states
events.title: All two-mode Gaussian states are settled
events.detail: Adesso proves equality for every two-mode Gaussian state and for bisymmetric multimode states, but not for generic nonsymmetric multimode states.

events.problemTitle: Kashaev volume conjecture for hyperbolic knots
events.title: The universal hyperbolic-knot statement remains open
events.detail: TheoremDB's dated review found proofs for selected knots and families but no proof or counterexample for every hyperbolic knot.

events.title: The two-copy Werner threshold is exact
events.detail: Four concurrent preprints prove that a Werner state is two-copy distillable exactly when it is one-copy distillable. Three-copy and all-copy distillability remain unresolved.

events.title: Two-copy Werner distillability is completely classified
events.detail: Four concurrent proofs settle two copies in every dimension but do not control three or more copies.

events.title: Large channel classes satisfy the conjectured decomposition
events.detail: Kumar and Wolf prove the strong form for qubit input, cq and qc channels, and a nonzero-measure set in every dimension; the general case remains open.

events.title: A new preprint claims a four-dimensional construction
events.detail: Faizal and Shabir claim a reflection-positive SU(N) continuum construction with a mass gap. The paper is unrefereed, and the official problem remains listed as unsolved.

events.problemTitle: SIC POVMs in infinitely many dimensions
events.title: Claimed all-dimension proof was withdrawn
events.detail: The arXiv withdrawal notice for Joka's manuscript states that the proof is incorrect.

events.title: An unconditional proof claim was withdrawn as incorrect
events.detail: The arXiv record for Joka's claimed all-dimension construction explicitly says the proof is not correct.

events.problemTitle: Asymptotic metrology with quantum-controlled causal order
events.title: A spacetime theorem identifies QC-QC as the physical target class
events.detail: Salzger and Vilasini show that protocols satisfying their classical-spacetime and closed-laboratory assumptions are behaviorally equivalent to QC-QC. The theorem narrows the physical scope but gives no asymptotic metrology bound.

events.problemTitle: Secret key from every entangled state
events.title: Current key-cost theory still treats zero-key entanglement as unresolved
events.detail: The peer-reviewed analysis states its conclusions conditionally on whether entangled states with zero distillable key exist.

events.title: Polyhedral sampling scales by giving up completeness
events.detail: Staufenbiel's sampling method finds millions of classes in large scenarios but explicitly does not enumerate every facet.

events.problemTitle: Mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
events.title: Peer-reviewed composite-dimension review keeps the case open
events.detail: McNulty and Weigert report that dimension six still has only three known MUBs and no accepted impossibility proof.

events.problemTitle: Mutually unbiased bases in general dimensions
events.title: Current review confirms the composite-dimension gap
events.detail: The peer-reviewed review records no general formula and keeps dimension six open.

events.title: A finite sufficient criterion is available
events.detail: The new finite test certifies catalytic transformations but is not necessary, so it does not replace the infinite exact characterization.

events.problemTitle: Mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
events.title: Claimed proof excluding seven MUBs is not accepted
events.detail: Joka's v3 preprint loses phase and projector data in its moment-map step, then uses that missing structure in an unsupported reduction argument.

events.problemTitle: Mutually unbiased bases in general dimensions
events.title: A dimension-six impossibility claim is not accepted
events.detail: The claimed MUB-to-Latin-square reduction loses essential phase and projector structure and does not establish the advertised result.

events.title: Explicit self-channel violations expose a quantifier trap
events.detail: Derksen and Lovitz give self-channel two-copy violations for every p greater than one. This solves the literal m equals two wording, but not delayed onset at m at least three.

events.problemTitle: Tightness of metrology bounds under correlated noise
events.title: The block hierarchy tightens without a convergence theorem
events.detail: Kurdziałek, Albarelli and Demkowicz-Dobrzański derive asymptotic bounds for correlated-noise combs and show how larger blocks improve them. They state that the bounds are not generally tight and prove no limit equality with the physical optimum.

events.title: Quantum-PCP reductions leave constant-gap hardness open
events.detail: Buhrman, Helsen and Weggemans prove reductions among quantum-PCP formulations and oracle barriers. Their results do not establish QMA-hardness for constant-gap Local Hamiltonian.

events.problemTitle: Mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
events.title: Comment identifies an error in an earlier structural lemma
events.detail: The peer-reviewed Comment invalidates support for three dependent theorems. A Reply salvages restricted statements, not the MUB existence problem.

events.problemTitle: SIC POVMs in infinitely many dimensions
events.title: Uniform construction remains conditional
events.detail: Appleby, Flammia and Kopp obtain all dimensions only under two unproved arithmetic and special-value conjectures.

events.title: A uniform construction is conditional on two conjectures
events.detail: Appleby, Flammia and Kopp require an order-one abelian Stark conjecture and a special-value identity for a modular cocycle.

events.title: A 4-by-n claim proves APPT, not absolute separability
events.detail: The theorem establishes an absolute-PPT criterion but does not prove that APPT equals absolute separability in this dimension.

events.problemTitle: Asymptotic metrology with quantum-controlled causal order
events.title: QC-QC has a strict advantage at three channel uses
events.detail: Mothe, Branciard and Abbott find noisy channel families for which QC-QC outperforms causal superpositions and fixed-order circuits at finite N. Their discussion leaves the large-N behavior open.

events.problemTitle: Asymptotic metrology with quantum-controlled causal order
events.title: Parallel, adaptive and causal-superposition strategies coincide asymptotically
events.detail: Kurdziałek and coauthors prove asymptotic equivalence through causal superpositions. Their proof does not cover dynamical quantum control of causal order.

events.title: Exact non-entangling maps remain irreversible
events.detail: Lami and Regula prove a separation between entanglement cost and distillation even under operations that generate no entanglement exactly.

events.title: NLTS Hamiltonians exist
events.detail: Anshu, Breuckmann and Nirkhe construct NLTS Hamiltonians from good quantum LDPC codes. NLTS supplies a required entanglement phenomenon but not the constant-gap QMA-hardness reduction.

events.problemTitle: Lockability of two-way distillable entanglement and key
events.title: Non-lockability is proved for irreducible private states
events.detail: The result controls two-way distillable key on a restricted family, not arbitrary bipartite states.

events.problemTitle: New extreme CPT classes with additivity
events.title: New extreme channel families do not supply the requested theorem
events.detail: Haagerup, Musat and Ruskai develop relevant extreme maps, but this does not yield a new positive additivity class answering the program.

events.problemTitle: Extreme CPT maps beyond qubit input
events.title: Fixed-rank channels receive a quotient-manifold parameterization
events.detail: Iten and Colbeck describe fixed-Kraus-rank channel sets as Stiefel quotients and identify smooth submanifolds of extreme channels.

events.title: PPT-assisted universal reversibility is refuted
events.detail: Wang and Duan exhibit states whose PPT entanglement cost exceeds PPT distillable entanglement.

events.problemTitle: Extreme CPT maps beyond qubit input
events.title: Important low-dimensional extreme maps are classified
events.detail: Friedland and Loewy settle qubit-to-qubit and qutrit-to-qubit cases and derive broader generic conditions.

events.title: Every qubit-qudit spectrum is characterized
events.detail: Johnston proves that APPT and absolute separability coincide for 2-by-n systems and gives the complete criterion there.

events.title: The stable invariant algebra has graph-indexed generators
events.detail: Vrana constructs systematic complete families and a free stable algebra, without solving the finite-dimensional minimal mixed-state problem.

events.title: Part A is refuted by a finite facet counterexample
events.detail: Bancal, Gisin and Pironio find two-party, two-setting, four-outcome facets that are neither CGLMP inequalities nor lower-outcome liftings.

events.title: Hastings violations already appear at two copies
events.detail: The random-channel counterexample to minimum-output-entropy additivity does not remain additive through lower nontrivial tensor powers.

events.title: Unrestricted random channels violate entropy additivity
events.detail: Hastings settles the general conjecture negatively, but his construction is not a family-specific solution to this structured search.

events.title: The inverse closest-state problem is solved
events.detail: Miranowicz and Ishizaka construct entangled states from a prescribed closest separable state and solve special families, but not the forward problem for arbitrary input states.

events.title: Numerics clarify the optimizer but do not prove Part B
events.detail: Global optimization shows that nonmaximally entangled states can outperform maximally entangled ones. The archived measurement claim must therefore retain its fixed-state qualifier.

events.problemTitle: Channel classes with multiplicativity at p = 2
events.title: PPT-inducing channels form a broad positive class
events.detail: Dierckx, Fannes and Vandenplas prove 2-norm multiplicativity when one tensor factor is PPT-inducing and the other is arbitrary.

events.title: Structural theory sharply constrains degradable channels
events.detail: Cubitt, Ruskai and Smith formalize the relevant channel structure and rank restrictions without producing the requested nontrivial pair.

events.title: Klimesh gives an exact infinite characterization
events.detail: A family of strict inequalities is necessary and sufficient for trumping under the theorem's support conditions.

events.title: Turgut derives independent exact conditions
events.detail: Power means and entropy give another necessary-and-sufficient infinite criterion for catalytic conversion.

events.title: General two-body N-representability is QMA-complete
events.detail: The complexity theorem gives a strong obstruction to any efficient general criterion, but does not identify the requested minimal invariants.

events.title: Random-channel violations motivate but do not settle the family
events.detail: Winter and Hayden disprove general multiplicativity for p greater than one using random constructions, without analyzing the specified polarized interpolation.

events.problemTitle: Coherent information of random sub-unitary channels
events.title: Bounded-Schmidt-rank tools address only the surrounding structure
events.detail: Sub-unitary and generic-channel methods provide context, but no full theorem for this cyclic family.

events.problemTitle: Maximally entangled relative maxima for sub-unitary channels
events.title: The Werner-Holevo critical point is a special case only
events.detail: Nathanson proves an analytic critical-point statement for the Werner-Holevo channel; private numerical evidence about relative maxima does not extend to arbitrary family parameters.

events.title: The closest positive theorem concerns another family
events.detail: Michalakis proves the p equals two case for identical polarized Werner-Holevo channels, not for arbitrary random sub-unitary channels.

events.title: Every polarization is settled at p = 2
events.detail: Michalakis proves maximal-output 2-norm multiplicativity for two identical depolarized Werner-Holevo channels in all dimensions.

events.problemTitle: Lockability of two-way distillable entanglement and key
events.title: Eve-side information obeys a different non-locking result
events.detail: The theorem concerns information held by an eavesdropper, not loss of a local qubit by Alice or Bob.

events.title: Completely bounded norms give forward additivity implications
events.detail: Devetak, Junge, King and Ruskai establish the foundational CB-norm connection, but not the converse classification requested here.

events.problemTitle: A direct proof for the two-Pauli qubit channel
events.title: A nearby entropy proof does not establish the requested norm theorem
events.detail: Amosov proves minimum-output-entropy additivity for the channel, not the direct maximal-output p-norm argument requested here.

events.title: The archived weighted-cost problem remains unresolved
events.detail: The cost is the infimum of the sum of absolute rotation angles. Modern Clifford-plus-T gate counts use a different resource measure.

events.problemTitle: Bell inequalities for long-range vacuum correlations
events.title: Arbitrary-distance harvesting reveals hidden nonlocality
events.detail: Reznik, Retzker and Silman obtain entanglement at arbitrary separation. Their detector state violates CHSH only after local filtering and postselection, not directly.

events.problemTitle: Lockability of two-way distillable entanglement and key
events.title: Several other entanglement measures can be locked
events.detail: One qubit can lock entanglement of formation, entanglement cost, logarithmic negativity and one-way distillable entanglement.

events.title: The unpolarized endpoint is settled through p = 2
events.detail: Datta proves multiplicativity for the Werner-Holevo endpoint throughout the interval from one to two.

events.problemTitle: Secret key from every entangled state
events.title: Some PPT bound-entangled states contain secret key
events.detail: Horodecki and collaborators construct bound-entangled states with positive distillable key, a major positive subclass that does not settle the universal quantifier.

events.problemTitle: A direct proof for the two-Pauli qubit channel
events.title: The theorem itself is known for every unital qubit channel
events.detail: King proves multiplicativity broadly, but via the sign-changing unitary-equivalence route excluded by this method-specific problem.

events.title: A full-correlation subclass is completely classified
events.detail: Werner and Wolf enumerate all full-correlation facets for arbitrary parties with two dichotomic observables per site, not the full probability polytope for arbitrary scenarios.

events.problemTitle: Kashaev volume conjecture for hyperbolic knots
events.title: Colored Jones polynomials give an equivalent formulation
events.detail: Murakami and Murakami identify Kashaev's invariant with a root-of-unity specialization of the colored Jones polynomial and state the volume conjecture in that language.

events.title: A structure-free lower bound is proved
events.detail: Knill, Laflamme and Viola show c(e,n) is greater than n divided by e squared times e squared plus one. No matching construction is known.
